tests.scope: Published portable ZIP and its ARX.exe
tests.findings: Published ZIP contains c904c0…; the earlier 1a1f03… executable is a different local build.
tests.recommendation: Continue anchoring binary tests to a fresh copy whose container hash matches the public release.

tests.scope: Native Windows host protection state
tests.findings: Three repeated measurements agree: Normal; service, AV, antispyware, real-time, behavior, I/O, network, and tamper protection enabled.
tests.recommendation: Do not alter Defender; retain timestamped raw fields when measuring release scans.

tests.scope: Exact wheel dependency closures for Python 3.10 and 3.11+
tests.findings: 0 known advisories; Python 3.10 resolves direct conditional tomli 2.4.1; 3.11+ has no runtime dependency.
tests.recommendation: Repeat against exact release metadata; review rather than auto-upgrade any future finding.

tests.scope: Python 3.10 and 3.14 dependency identities
tests.findings: Two CycloneDX 1.6 and two SPDX 2.3 documents parse; privacy scan found no forbidden marker.
tests.recommendation: Generate from final reviewed distributions and associate the validated SBOM with future provenance.

tests.scope: Exact wheel, sdist, portable ZIP, published ARX.exe, installer
tests.findings: 5/5 exact reviewed targets returned NO_THREATS_FOUND.
tests.recommendation: Rescan final bytes after any future build or signing operation.

tests.scope: Exact copied Beta 1 artifacts in isolated WSL
tests.findings: 5/5 exact reviewed targets returned OK; no upload and no resident daemon.
tests.recommendation: Keep second-engine scans isolated and require explicit approval before any third-party upload.

tests.scope: src, scripts, packaging
tests.findings: Reviewed: 0 critical, 0 high, 1 medium, 9 low, 13 informational. Medium: package-index download URL lacks an independent exact-host/redirect/size boundary.
tests.recommendation: Harden the future index verifier without changing immutable Beta 1; preserve all scanner evidence.

tests.scope: Python source/tests and GitHub Actions
tests.findings: Python: 1 low environment trust-boundary finding. Actions: 0 findings, but approximately 79.1% parsed with 6 pwsh-as-Bash warnings.
tests.recommendation: Validate the vswhere path from a trusted Windows source; retain CodeQL and workflow tests for Actions coverage.

tests.scope: Exact release commit; Python and GitHub Actions
tests.findings: 0 results across 43 Python and 17 Actions rules; 0 open or closed repository alerts at observation time.
tests.recommendation: Keep the pinned workflow and treat zero alerts as a defined query result, not proof of absence.

tests.scope: ARX-owned parsers, response parsing, redaction, and serialization
tests.findings: 10 tests: 5 passed, 5 failed in 67.012 s. Failures classify as 2 test-assumption errors and 3 harness defects; 0 confirmed product defects.
tests.recommendation: Correct and independently review the harness, then rerun all three properties that never reached product code.

tests.tool: mt.exe, ACL inspection, source review, pytest
tests.scope: Manifest, paths, installer policy, access-denial behavior
tests.findings: asInvoker; protected Program Files/per-user credential ACLs; permission-failure regression passed. Direct standard-user lifecycle was unavailable on the elevated host.
tests.recommendation: Run standard-user install/upgrade/uninstall/UAC cases in a disposable Windows VM.

tests.scope: Copies only: mutation, truncation, corruption, manifest, extra/missing public artifacts
tests.findings: 6/6 required copied-artifact cases rejected. Auxiliary non-public .txt files are outside verifier scope.
tests.recommendation: Retain exact upload allowlists; add independent authenticity through signing/provenance in a future release.

tests.scope: Published ARX.exe and installer
tests.findings: Both binaries are NotSigned; no trusted production code-signing certificate was found.
tests.recommendation: Use a protected, human-gated signing system for a future release and verify final signed bytes before checksums/provenance.

tests.tool: ARX build scripts / PyInstaller / Inno Setup / structural analyzer
tests.scope: Two detached clean builds at the exact release commit
tests.findings: 0 bit-for-bit; 5 structurally equivalent; installer conservatively NOT REPRODUCIBLE.
tests.recommendation: Normalize timestamps/order, fix hash seed/build inputs, and add an Inno 7-compatible payload comparison.

tests.scope: Exact TestPyPI wheel and sdist
tests.findings: Both subjects and SHA-256 digests cryptographically verify to the expected GitHub repository, workflow, and testpypi environment.
tests.recommendation: Preserve the existing Trusted Publisher identity and exact subject checks.

tests.scope: All five exact GitHub release artifacts
tests.findings: No GitHub artifact attestation was found for any reviewed Beta 1 SHA-256.
tests.recommendation: Attest all future release artifacts and the checksum manifest with OIDC; do not retrofit Beta 1.

tests.scope: Mocked provider transports and localhost only
tests.findings: 48 mocked and 2 localhost tests passed; redirect and oversized response rejection reached the real urllib transport. ARX exposes no inbound service, so conventional DAST is not applicable.
tests.recommendation: Keep external targets out of DAST; exercise outbound behavior with mocks/localhost.

tests.scope: Tracked/staged files and exact public release artifacts
tests.findings: 0 credential-shaped or host-identity findings in staged durable evidence; exact release verifier privacy scan passed.
tests.recommendation: Keep raw local logs with host/synthetic-secret metadata out of Git while retaining hashes and sanitized classifications.

tests.scope: ARX.exe from the checksum-verified published portable ZIP
tests.findings: The target was not evaluated because no loadable PDB was available; ignorePdbLoadError changed the process exit but still produced executionSuccessful=false and zero rule results.
tests.recommendation: Preserve a compatible reviewed PDB or establish documented symbol-independent BinSkim coverage for a future build; never call zero results from an unsuccessful invocation clean.

tests.scope: Repository tests plus audit localhost tests
tests.findings: 221 passed, 0 failed in 13.67 seconds.
tests.recommendation: Retain the same no-external-target test boundary for future audit branches.

tests.scope: 41 GUI tests, one isolated Windows process per test
tests.findings: 41 passed, 0 failed.
tests.recommendation: Keep GUI tests process-isolated to prevent Tk state contamination.

tests.scope: arx-prescanner 4.0.0b1 production PyPI state
tests.findings: Production PyPI has no 4.0.0b1 version; publication workflow remains disabled_manually.
tests.recommendation: Do not enable or dispatch production publication until every human and security gate is explicitly reviewed.

findings_requiring_review.finding: Published Windows executable and installer are unsigned; no production signing identity exists.
findings_requiring_review.security_relevance: Users cannot authenticate Windows publisher identity through Authenticode.
findings_requiring_review.remediation: Acquire/approve a trusted hardware-backed signing identity and use a protected human gate.

findings_requiring_review.finding: No tested artifact is bit-for-bit reproducible; the installer is not independently structurally verified.
findings_requiring_review.security_relevance: Independent rebuilds cannot reproduce the published bytes exactly.
findings_requiring_review.remediation: Normalize time/order/hash inputs and establish an Inno 7 payload comparison.

findings_requiring_review.finding: The five GitHub release artifacts have no GitHub artifact attestations.
findings_requiring_review.security_relevance: The GitHub assets lack an OIDC-bound build provenance record.
findings_requiring_review.remediation: Attest future exact outputs with a pinned action and minimal OIDC permissions.

findings_requiring_review.finding: The package-index verifier downloads an index-supplied file URL without a separate exact-host, redirect, or size boundary.
findings_requiring_review.security_relevance: A compromised/malformed index response could redirect the verifier before the existing digest check.
findings_requiring_review.remediation: Validate HTTPS host/port, reject redirects, and bound bytes while retaining exact SHA-256.

findings_requiring_review.finding: Three Hypothesis properties stopped at a function-scoped tmp_path health check before product code ran.
findings_requiring_review.security_relevance: PE, directory metadata, and archive robustness properties remain unexecuted.
findings_requiring_review.remediation: Correct the audit harness, independently review it, and rerun the bounded campaign.

findings_requiring_review.finding: Direct standard-user and full installer lifecycle behavior was unavailable on the elevated non-disposable host.
findings_requiring_review.security_relevance: The observed static boundaries do not replace real standard-user/UAC lifecycle evidence.
findings_requiring_review.remediation: Exercise separate standard-user/admin accounts in a disposable Windows VM.

findings_requiring_review.finding: ProgramFiles(x86) can influence the absolute vswhere executable path used for a fixed discovery probe.
findings_requiring_review.security_relevance: A hostile same-privilege environment can redirect local tool execution.
findings_requiring_review.remediation: Derive the installation root from a trusted native source or validate path ownership/location.

findings_requiring_review.finding: BinSkim could not evaluate the published PyInstaller executable because no loadable PDB was available.
findings_requiring_review.security_relevance: PE/MSIL rule coverage was not obtained; zero rule results came from an unsuccessful invocation and are not clean evidence.
findings_requiring_review.remediation: Preserve a compatible reviewed PDB or establish documented symbol-independent BinSkim coverage for a future build.
